summary.en: The body of Satoshi is found at the stream near the Spiral Mansion, much to Maimai’s misery. The police begin to verify the alibis of the remaining suspects at 1:15 PM, the estimated time when he died. Maimai was working at the studio again after the interrogation; while Neji was talking to Hayase; and Yoko was standing where Conan came to ask for the blueprint, with the only exception of going to the restroom. Conan arrives at the place where Satoshi was finishing his newest sketch for investigation, then he wanders around the mansion and overhears the conversation between Yoko and Maimai about splitting properties after the case is over. However, since Sensuke had already decided that his father’s art would belong to the museum, both of them will have "zero divided by any non-zero natural number equals zero" in terms of property. Maimai has no problem with that, but Yoko does as she angrily leaves the room. After she is not in Conan’s eyes range, Maimai comes out and asks him what he wants. He says that he wants to see her husband’s latest sketch, to which she agrees. Conan notices that the drawing is double-layered, with the outer layer usually used to correct the inner layer, making her wonder what is in the inner layer. Much to her shock, she finds out that Satoshi has been using his sketch as a way to sell her father’s art, even though she was extremely upset with the news, she still tells Conan not to reveal this to anyone. He agrees to.
